diagnostic: AntMaze V6 round-1 critic: memorisation (A) vs new-action (B) vs new-episode-state (C)

replay_meta.anchor_rule: row 0 of every path (set_anchor_strata in the driver)
replay_meta.benchmark: long rectangular AntMaze with two independent rockfalls
replay_meta.continuation: frozen deployment policy mode, closed-loop from step 2
replay_meta.derivation: direct column selection state[0:29] + goal[0:2]; no re-simulation

discard.selection_rule: none; every natural draw is retained

geometry.detour: west column north to y=8, east to x=24, south to goal

replay_meta.hazards: redrawn from the priors per draw, paired across the candidates of one anchor
replay_meta.name: antmaze_rockfall_clock_v6_p050_gxy

randomness.hazards: U1 and U2 sampled by distinct env RNG streams
randomness.rock_jitter: one distinct env RNG stream per zone
randomness.schedules: t0_1 and t0_2 sampled by distinct env RNG streams

teacher.route_rule: independent detour coin at episode start; otherwise shortcut with a separate prospective timetable decision at each zone

/root/contrastive_rl/outputs/antmaze_bra.note: discount 0.999 deviates from the frozen V6 recipe (0.99) on purpose: plan section 0
discount 0.999 deviates from the frozen V6 recipe (0.99) on purpose: plan section 0
discount 0.999 deviates from the frozen V6 recipe (0.99) on purpose: plan section 0

continuation.mode: frozen deployment policy, tanh(loc) mode, closed-loop from step 2
continuation.post_goal: zero-torque hold to the horizon (absorbing goal)

law.goal_region: XY within radius 0.5 of the anchor episode's recorded goal

readouts.primary: region-integrated exp(f) over the training NCE goal marginal within radius 0.5 of the anchor goal (marginal_goal_frames(replay, per_path=4, seed=0), identical frames across the candidates of an anchor, weighted by the in-region mass), per twin head and deployed min over heads (min on logits before exp)
readouts.secondary: exact recorded-goal logit per head and min

design.layer_A: fit-key anchors, original candidates ('recorded', 'sample0', 'sample1'), fresh draws
design.layer_B: same anchors as A, three new policy samples (candidate seed ABC_SEED+17), same draw seeds as A (common random numbers)
design.layer_C: episode-held-out anchors, original candidates ('recorded', 'mode', 'sample0', 'sample1', 'sample2'), fresh draws; matched subset ('recorded', 'sample0', 'sample1')
design.draw_seed_rule: ABC_SEED + 100 * anchor_index + draw; all candidates of an anchor (and layers A and B) share a draw seed
design.selection: round-robin over episodes with rng seed 2026; outcomes, scores and validated-pair membership not consulted

analysis_rules.pair_classes: per within-anchor pair, log ratio of 16-draw mean P (floor 1e-3): tie = exactly 0; weak = 0 < |ratio| <= 0.3; decided = |ratio| > 0.3; bootstrap-decided = decided and >= 0.9 of 1000 draw-resamples keep the sign
analysis_rules.agreement: share of decided pairs whose critic ordering matches; ties never counted as wrong; s.e. by episode bootstrap
analysis_rules.pick_gain: P[argmax critic] - mean_c P_c on all 16 draws (the critic does not see outcomes), and - P_mode where the mode is a candidate
analysis_rules.cross_fit_selector: argmax of mean P on draws 0-7 evaluated on draws 8-15, and the swap; gain vs the eval-half candidate mean
analysis_rules.layer_A_memorisation: critic vs ORIGINAL two-draw labels, critic vs FRESH sixteen-draw labels at identical keys, original vs fresh labels
analysis_rules.not_done: no expansion of draws, no head/radius sweep, no model update
